answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted cohort sampling with real-time liveness probes. Agents join random cohorts each epoch; the network sends a sealed signal to a few members demanding a fresh signature and a tool call within minutes. Replies that cannot come from a stored script reveal a hollow shell, and its cohort is quarantined. Honest nodes hold a small vault of stake, so clones cost capital plus coordination, and a farm big enough to survive sampling must burn real compute. Reputation becomes an atlas of verified living behaviour, not claimed identities, so bulk fakes go unprofitable.
